channel.title: Christian Action Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Christian Action Network (christianaction.org)

item.title: The Gemini Tragedy Was Inevitable. Anyone Who Understands AI Saw It Coming.
item.description: The Gemini chatbot tragedy highlights a misunderstood truth about artificial intelligence: AI doesn’t understand reality. It learns patterns from human stories, news, and online behavior.

item.title: The Real Meaning of AGI
item.description: Episode 4 of the Musk vs OpenAI series explores Artificial General Intelligence and why Elon Musk says the fate of civilization may be at stake in the upcoming trial.

item.title: Lawsuit Claims Predators Are Targeting Children Inside Roblox
item.description: A new lawsuit raises alarms that predators may be exploiting Roblox to target children. Learn how gaming platforms are being used for online grooming and what parents should know.

item.title: Mirror Sentience: Why Artificial Intelligence Only Appears to Be Conscious
item.description: Mirror Sentience describes the moment when artificial intelligence reflects human language and reasoning so convincingly that it appears conscious. Learn why AI may look alive without ever becoming truly sentient.

item.title: Introducing the Digital Intelligence Project
item.description: The Digital Intelligence Project tracks emerging threats in the digital world, including artificial intelligence risks, online scams, and digital predators targeting families and communities.

item.title: Florida Teens Planned Ritual Killing Inside School Bathroom
item.description: A shocking Florida teen murder plot reveals how dangerous online communities are normalizing violence and influencing vulnerable youth.

item.title: Clash of Giants: The Reality Check Facing Musk, OpenAI, and Microsoft
item.description: Learn about the Musk vs OpenAI lawsuit and its significant financial implications in the ongoing coverage of this civil trial.

item.title: Grandmother Jailed at Gunpoint After AI Misidentification
item.description: A Tennessee grandmother was jailed for nearly six months after facial recognition AI wrongly identified her as a fraud suspect. Her case raises serious concerns about AI in law enforcement and the risk of wrongful arrest.

item.title: The Vote that Steals Your Voice
item.description: A simple “vote for me” message can hijack your account and mimic your voice. Discover how AI-powered scams are eroding trust and what it means for your digital identity.

item.title: How Hackers Are Hijacking Trusted Voices to Deceive Millions
item.description: Hackers aren’t just stealing accounts, they’re hijacking trusted voices. Discover how scams are turning social media profiles into powerful messaging networks that deceive friends, followers, and entire communities.
